changes.title: Treehouse v2
items: The treehouse is about twice the size, its rooms drawn as isometric boxes
Inside the treehouse she walks on foot, with her own standing and walking animations
She takes to her broom stepping off the balcony, and steps off it when she lands back on

changes.title: No first frame freeze
items: The start of a night no longer freezes for seconds on its first frame, and sailing to a new night doesn't compile the game's shaders all over again

changes.title: Chart stay
items: On the sea chart, the island you're on now says "Back to the party" (or "Back to the afterparty" once the party's over): choosing it closes the chart and you're back where you were, with no sailing and no new night. Going to bed is still how to start the same island again
